questions.explanation: Here, “care about” means “to consider something important”.

questions.explanation: Here, “plenty of” means “a large enough number”.

passages.text: Our group is choosing a place for a small class display about local plants. I agree with Lina that the bright wall near the door will be easy for visitors to notice. Before using it, we ask the teacher for permission because another group may need the space. She checks the class plan and finds that the wall is free next week. We measure the space and choose only the pictures that will fit without covering the door notice. Our final plan records both the location and the date when we may put up the display.

parallelText.en: Our group is choosing a place for a small class display about local plants.
parallelText.zh: 我们小组正在为一个本地植物的小展示选择位置。

parallelText.en: I agree with Lina that the bright wall near the door will be easy for visitors to notice.
parallelText.zh: 我同意莉娜的看法：门边明亮的墙容易被参观者注意到。

parallelText.en: Before using it, we ask the teacher for permission because another group may need the space.
parallelText.zh: 使用前，我们先请老师许可，因为另一组可能也需要这块地方。

parallelText.en: She checks the class plan and finds that the wall is free next week.
parallelText.zh: 她查看班级计划，发现那面墙下周空着。

parallelText.en: We measure the space and choose only the pictures that will fit without covering the door notice.
parallelText.zh: 我们测量空间，只选能放得下而不会盖住门口通知的图片。

parallelText.en: Our final plan records both the location and the date when we may put up the display.
parallelText.zh: 最终计划记录展示位置和可以布置的日期。

wordHelp.meaning: agreement that someone may do something

passages.text: The community centre invites families to an afternoon of simple indoor games. The helpers prepare games such as matching pictures and building paper towers. Quite a few families arrive early, so the helpers open a second table before the start. Each table has a short instruction card that parents and children can read together. When one game becomes crowded, a helper explains the other choices rather than rushing anyone. By spreading across the tables, the visitors find enough room to enjoy the activities.

parallelText.en: The community centre invites families to an afternoon of simple indoor games.
parallelText.zh: 社区中心邀请家庭参加一个简单室内游戏下午场。

parallelText.en: The helpers prepare games such as matching pictures and building paper towers.
parallelText.zh: 帮忙者准备了配图、搭纸塔等游戏。

parallelText.en: Quite a few families arrive early, so the helpers open a second table before the start.
parallelText.zh: 相当多家庭提前到达，因此帮忙者在开始前又开了一张桌子。

parallelText.en: Each table has a short instruction card that parents and children can read together.
parallelText.zh: 每张桌上都有一张简短说明卡，家长和孩子可以一起读。

parallelText.en: When one game becomes crowded, a helper explains the other choices rather than rushing anyone.
parallelText.zh: 某个游戏区拥挤时，帮忙者介绍其他选择，而不催促任何人。

parallelText.en: By spreading across the tables, the visitors find enough room to enjoy the activities.
parallelText.zh: 参观者分散到不同桌边后，都有足够空间享受活动。
